purpose: Sends pre-approved appointment reminders to prospects at configured offsets before a confirmed appointment, honouring opt-outs and quiet hours.

configurationFields.description: Only client-approved templates may be sent
No messages sent in this local-time window
live only after Gate 2 and operator activation

permissionsRequired: Send email / WhatsApp template messages to prospects who gave contact consent

testCases.expectedOutcome: Reminder rendered and logged; nothing sent
Deferred to end of quiet hours

rollbackApproach: Set mode=dry-run or deactivate the workflow in n8n immediately; no queued messages are sent after deactivation.
